summary: Reconcile mission reads by their consumed claim predicates instead of unrelated seat heartbeats

replay.detail: No durable claim or projection changes.

schema.detail: Dependency indexes and work counters are process-local.

rules.detail: Kind-filtered claim reads record subject-and-kind inputs. Desired selection and actual-state reads use distinct projection inputs, so harness reports do not reconstruct missions that only read eligibility or actual state. True liveness readers retain their existing dependencies. Post-evaluation run-state reduction reads current effective step states without rebuilding definitions, execution clocks, handoffs, loops or lineage.

compatibility.detail: GET /v1/performance adds mission_reads.reconstructions and mission_reads.state_refreshes, cumulative per-store work counts since process start.

downtime.detail: Takes effect on daemon restart; no migration.

recovery.detail: Binary rollback requires no data conversion.
